segments.text: This is an official collection of clawed plugins from Anthropic for financial services workflows. It covers investment banking, equity research, private
equity, and wealth management. The plugins include skills, slash commands, sub aents, and MCP connectors for workflows like research reports,
comparable company analysis, deal sourcing, and portfolio tracking. Everything is just marked down in JSON. No code, no infrastructure.
